releaseTitle: Release Gate Identity and Immutable Deployment Pinning Repair
notes: Makes source manifests deterministic by hashing tracked source instead of generated release-gate artifacts.
Derives certification commit and source identity from the clean testing checkout instead of requiring duplicate manual environment values.
Pins the full release gate to the immutable Vercel deployment discovered during preflight before any deployed tests run.
Separates optional delivered-archive evidence from deployable source identity while preserving fail-closed commit, branch, version, project, Firebase, and protected-config checks.
Carries complete preflight identity evidence into final certification and keeps postflight deployment drift detection mandatory.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.4
summary: Repairs certification identity so the full release gate can bind clean local source to one immutable Vercel deployment and actually execute the required tests.
description: Preserves 17.0.3 application behavior while making release identity deterministic, excluding generated gate artifacts, pinning deployed testing to an immutable preview, and keeping certification fail-closed.
